notes:
Passed the acceptance gate on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null). The package serves the first confirmed entry symbol, roboschool:RoboschoolInvertedPendulum (RoboschoolInvertedPendulum-v1); the other entry symbols in the card (InvertedPendulumSwingup, InvertedDoublePendulum, Reacher, Hopper) are not implemented, one device per package. The upstream registers a legacy gym environment, not a gymnasium one; the Gymnasium family bridge supports its four-tuple step and seed path. The card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but gym, numpy and the compiled Bullet scene are not importable where the gate runs, so the fake backend is the package's pure Python stand-in (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gym.make(env_id)) was not run. The fake reproduces the five-element observation, the action clipping and the 0.2 rad termination rule but uses placeholder dynamics, ignores reset options and adds the gym.make 1000-step truncation; the fidelity gaps state this. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, and the dimensionless action.values[*]); these are the expected family warnings (PLAYBOOK section 8), and there is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY. No site-limits overlay is needed (simulated R0, no operator-required bound). No x-cap ids were used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
